name: Ringmetall SE
summary: Headquartered in Munich, Germany, and established in 1997, Ringmetall SE is a global developer, manufacturer, and marketer of specialized solutions across two main business areas: Industrial Packaging and Industrial Handling. The Industrial Packaging division offers a comprehensive portfolio for industrial drums and pails, encompassing drum locking systems, clamping rings, and a wide variety of inliners such as round bottom, drum, IBC, and container liners. This segment also provides essential individual components, including covers, seals, locking divisions, handles, and other custom-engineered parts, alongside dust caps, form lids, and bag-in-box components. Complementing this, the Industrial Handling segment manufactures specialized vehicle components for industrial trucks, tractors, and agricultural machinery. These products include critical items like restraint systems and lifting mast parts for forklifts, unique brake and clutch pedals, complex welding assemblies, and custom trailer coupling systems. Additionally, it supplies brackets for hydraulic components vital to forestry and agriculture. Ringmetall's diverse client base spans sectors such as automotive, food and beverage, chemical, petrochemical, pharmaceutical, oil and gas, building and construction, and logistics.
